questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to express surprise at a rare occurrence?
options: It was surprising that she had never met him before.
Had she never met him before, it would have been surprising.
She had never met him before, so it was surprising.
She was surprised that she had never met him before.
questions.answer: Had she never met him before, it would have been surprising.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to emphasise the subject of a clause?
options: The reason he failed the exam was his lack of preparation.
It was his lack of preparation that caused him to fail the exam.
He failed the exam because he didn’t study enough.
The exam was so difficult that he failed it due to poor effort.
questions.answer: It was his lack of preparation that caused him to fail the exam.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a third conditional with a passive construction in a formal context?
options: If she had studied more, she would have passed the exam.
If the exam had been more difficult, she would have failed it.
Had the project been completed on time, feedback would have been immediate.
She would have received praise if she had submitted her work earlier.
questions.answer: Had the project been completed on time, feedback would have been immediate.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario involving a hypothetical situation?
options: I wish I go to Paris next summer.
I wish I could go to Paris next summer.
If I were you, I would take that job.
She insists that he leave the meeting immediately.
questions.answer: I wish I could go to Paris next summer.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates the use of ellipsis and formal register in a professional context?
options: The team is working on a proposal. They’ll send it to the client next week.
The proposal is being finalised; we’ll submit it shortly.
The client will receive the document once it’s reviewed by the department.
They’ve completed the draft. We’ll finalise it before the deadline.
questions.answer: The proposal is being finalised; we’ll submit it shortly.
